image.notes: Shows exactly the line: the younger person touches the elder's feet and the elder answers with a hand on his head. Caveats: the person in the picture is named in the title and is the uploader ('own work' although he is in the photo - common on Commons, but mention it); his face is the clearest face (blur if needed).
